review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer
review_candidates.company: CTME CNC MACHINE AND ELECTRICAL SERVICES
review_candidates.description: Company Description CTME CNC MACHINE AND ELECTRICAL SERVICES provides specialized solutions for CNC machinery and electrical systems, supporting clients across manufacturing and industrial sectors. The company focuses on reliable maintenance, technical services, and equipment optimization to help customers improve productivity and reduce downtime. By combining technical expertise with customer-centered service, CTME aims to deliver practical, high-quality solutions tailored to each client’s requirements. Team members collaborate closely with customers and internal stakeholders to solve complex technical problems and support long-term operational success. Role Description The Sales Engineer role is a full-time remote position responsible for connecting customer needs with CTME’s CNC machine and electrical service solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging prospective and existing clients, understanding their technical and operational requirements, and proposing appropriate service offerings and solutions. The Sales Engineer will prepare quotes and proposals, deliver product and service presentations, and collaborate with technical teams to ensure accurate solution design. This role also involves providing pre- and post-sales technical support, responding to customer inquiries, and maintaining strong relationships to drive repeat business and growth. The Sales Engineer will track opportunities in a CRM system, report on sales activities, and contribute feedback on customer needs to support continuous improvement. Qualifications Strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to understand customer requirements and translate them into effective CNC and electrical service solutions. Sales and Customer Service skills to build relationships, manage the sales cycle, and deliver a positive customer experience. Effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, technical presentations, and the ability to explain complex concepts in accessible terms. Familiarity with CNC machinery, industrial electrical systems, or related technical environments; ability to learn new technologies and service offerings quickly. Proven ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time and priorities, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Experience using CRM or sales management tools to track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in a technical sales or service role. Willingness to occasionally travel to customer sites, trade shows, or internal meetings as needed.
